newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Oct industrial production up 15.5 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Oct industrial production up 15.5 pct y/y.

text.p: Turkish October industrial production grew 15.5 percent from a year earlier, compared with a 1.9-percent rise in September, the State Statistics Institute (DIE) said in a statement.
In October 1995, industrial production was up 2.2 percent year-on-year.
The DIE said the manufacturing sector grew 15.5 percent year-on-year in October, compared with September's growth of 0.1 percent.
Production in the mining sector was up 24.5 percent in October from a year earlier after growth of 23.6 percent in September.
In the first ten months of the year, total industrial production grew 6.6 percent from the previous year compared with growth of 7.6 percent a year earlier.
The DIE said mining sector production was up 7.8 percent, manufacturing production up 5.9 percent and utilities output up 10.5 percent in the ten months to October.
